glosses: stain, blemish, mark, spot (discoloured spot or visible impression)
a disgrace, discredit in one’s reputation

examples.text: Havia manchas de sangue no chão.
examples.en: There were blood stains on the floor.

examples.text: "O que são estas manchas no chão?" "Sangue."
examples.en: "What are these stains on the floor?" "Blood."

examples.text: Esta mancha não pode ser removida.
